description: Opening a profile from the People dialog replaces the dialog; when that profile is closed (Escape or Close) focus lands on <body> instead of the "+4" button that opened the People dialog. Keyboard and screen-reader users are dropped to the top of the document.
expected: Closing the profile returns focus to the "+N" button (or reopens the People dialog with focus on the chosen name).
actual: document.activeElement === body after Escape and after Close (log.json afterEsc/afterClose).
suggested_fix: When a profile is opened from the People dialog, carry the People dialog's opener (+N button) as the profile's return-focus target, or return to the People dialog.

description: Profile from the People dialog has no way back to the list; checking a second person needs +N again (3 steps per person).
expected: A Back control in the profile when it was opened from the People dialog.
suggested_fix: Add a "Back to people" button or show the profile inline in the People dialog.

description: Every person who joins gets an auto-created Codex agent named "Setup agent". With three humans that produces three identical "SA · Setup agent · Agent · Offline" rows in the People dialog; they differ only inside the profile ("Dev Patel's agent"). In the header they push real teammates behind +N.
expected: Agent rows identify their human ("Setup agent · Dev Patel") or default names are unique; unused setup agents are not listed as members.
suggested_fix: Show the owner in the People row for agents ("Dev Patel's agent") and consider naming default agents after the harness and human.

description: An agent's profile shows its human's Git name, Git email and device (Otter: Git name "Maya Okafor", maya@harbor.test, maya-studio), directly under "Harness Codex". It reads as if the agent had Maya's identity.
expected: Agent profile either omits the human's Git identity or labels it as the human's ("Commits as Maya Okafor").
actual: Git name/email identical to the human's with no qualifier (the story expected "Not reported").
suggested_fix: Label the rows as belonging to the human, or omit them for agents since Works for already names the human.

description: The People dialog's Close button sits immediately after the title, while the Profile dialog right-aligns Close. Name buttons are styled as underlined links.
expected: Both dialogs place Close in the same spot.
actual: Close at x≈697 next to the title vs right-aligned in the profile.
suggested_fix: Use the same dialog header layout for both.
